name: morsel
description: Morsel MCP food tracker — remote app connection plus the corrected food-logging skill (eaten vs TDEE goal).

interface.longDescription:
Morsel is a food tracker that lives in your ChatGPT conversation. Log meals as you eat — type what you had, or share a photo of your plate — and Morsel records the food, matches it to real nutrition data, and keeps your personal food log up to date.

Use the bundled food-logging skill for meal logging, history readback, and progress against your daily goal: calories eaten are compared with the effective TDEE-based goal, and Apple Health activity appears only as a separate note.

Your data stays yours: everything is scoped to your Morsel account and shared with no one. Disconnect the plugin at any time and access stops immediately.
defaultPrompt: Log my lunch: a grilled chicken sandwich, a side salad, and a sparkling water.
Show my day so far: meals, calories, and protein remaining versus my goal.
I took a photo of my dinner plate — log the meal from the photo.
